name: Edwin Saghian
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in West Hollywood, California
about: For nearly 17 years, Edwin Saghian has been at the forefront of progressing client service in the legal industry to higher standards through his efficacious advocacy and compassionate legal counsel. A founding partner at the Omega Law Group in California, he helps injured victims across Los Angeles County and throughout the state in matters pertaining to motor vehicle accidents, truck collisions, catastrophic injuries, ride-sharing accidents, brain injuries and drunk driving accidents, among many others.

With a genuine desire to help his clients gain the normalcy they seek after suffering an injury, Mr. Saghian is steadfast in his goals and maintains a level-headed approach to getting them peace of mind and relief. He has been a bastion of high ethics and leadership within his legal community, advocating for creative and innovative solutions to problems that require an out-of-box approach. For his many contributions, he has been recognized by the National Trial Lawyers in their Top 40 Under 40 list and holds a perfect “10.0” rating on Avvo, along with many positive client testimonials on the latter site.

Mr. Saghian is a 2005 B.S. degree graduate from the University of Southern California. He went on to attend the Loyola Marymount University – Loyola Law School and received his Juris Doctor in 2009. Becoming licensed to practice law in California the same year he graduated from law school, he is also admitted before all the federal district courts in California and the United States Court of Appeals for the 9th Circuit. Within his legal community, he is a member of the Consumer Attorneys Association of Los Angeles and the Conseumer Attorneys of California.
honors: Recipient of the Prestigious Loyola Scholarship , Loyola Law School, Los Angeles, CA
